name: WCEHB
recent: WCE Holdings 公布 2026 年 9 月止季度业绩，营收 1.548 亿令吉，净亏损扩大至约 4,200 万至 5,000 万令吉，主要受 Section 7B 成本与建筑成本上升影响。同期公司根据员工认股计划（ESOS）授出 2,369.8 万份期权，行使价 RM0.664。大股东 Tan Sri Dato' Surin Upatkoon 在 9 月至 10 月间多次申报持股变动。
notable: 根据 ESOS 授出 2,369.8 万份期权，行使价 RM0.664，首席执行官 Lyndon Alfred Felix 获 265 万份。
ESOS 于 2026 年 9 月 4 日生效，股东已于 2026 年 8 月 24 日特别股东大会批准。
大股东 Tan Sri Dato' Surin Upatkoon 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月间多次申报持股变动。
risks: 季度净亏损扩大，主要受 Section 7B 成本与建筑成本上升影响。
ESOS 期权未来行使可能带来股权摊薄。
大股东在 9 月至 10 月间多次申报持股变动，具体增减未在标题中说明。
earnings: 2026 年 9 月止季度营收 1.548 亿令吉，净亏损约 4,200 万至 5,000 万令吉，较上一季度净亏损 2,450 万令吉（净利率 -17.4%）扩大；营收环比增长 5.0%，但同比减少 64.3%。

recent_en: WCE Holdings reported results for the quarter ended September 2026 with revenue of RM154.8 million and a wider net loss of about RM42-50 million, mainly due to Section 7B costs and higher construction costs. The company also offered 23.698 million ESOS options at an exercise price of RM0.664. Substantial shareholder Tan Sri Dato' Surin Upatkoon filed multiple changes in his shareholding between September and October.
notable_en: Offered 23.698 million ESOS options at an exercise price of RM0.664, with CEO Lyndon Alfred Felix receiving 2.65 million options.
The ESOS became effective on 4 September 2026, after shareholders' approval at the EGM held on 24 August 2026.
Substantial shareholder Tan Sri Dato' Surin Upatkoon filed multiple changes in his shareholding between September and October 2026.
risks_en: Quarterly net loss widened, mainly due to Section 7B costs and higher construction costs.
Future exercise of ESOS options may lead to shareholding dilution.
The substantial shareholder filed multiple shareholding changes between September and October; the exact increase or decrease is not specified in the titles.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended September 2026, revenue was RM154.8 million and net loss was about RM42-50 million, wider than the previous quarter's net loss of RM24.5 million (net margin -17.4%); revenue grew 5.0% QoQ but fell 64.3% YoY.
